name: Step×Steady
source:
"Hurry up, or you'll be late!" Chihiro is a high school student, who hasn't had a girlfriend ever since he was born. One day, a female student transfers to his school. While she is introducing herself to the class, she suddenly says to Chihiro, "I love you." He doesn't know what's going on...? Izumi, his childhood friend, gets confused, too...

[From ErogeShop]
translation:
“快点，不然要迟到了！”千寻是一名高中生，自出生以来从未有过女朋友。某天，一位女学生转到了他的学校。在她向全班自我介绍时，她突然对千寻说：“我喜欢你。”他不知道发生了什么……？他的青梅竹马和泉也困惑不已……

[引自ErogeShop]
